Keeps the frame awake during its active hours so the scheduled sleep/wake keeps working on devices with aggressive power saving.
The frame keeps itself running during its active hours (Active Times).
Recommended on Huawei/EMUI and other devices that stop apps when the screen turns off. Shows a small permanent notification and keeps the frame running during its active hours.
Check the schedule, the wake alarm and the device admin, test sleep/wake on the spot and read the event log.
